sourceTruth.countingRule: 2025 orphan = cad_property row at tax_year=2025 with no identical (county_fips, prop_id) row at tax_year=2026.

sampleVerification.query: 30 deterministic lowest-key orphans, 15 per county, joined by indexed txgio_parcel (county_fips, prop_id)
sampleVerification.result: 30/30 linked to a geometry row by the 2025 prop_id; sampled geometry owner/situs agreed with the 2025 cad row where populated.
sampleVerification.tarrantFinding: Sample orphan 10-1-1A is a real commercial parcel in the 2026 public TAD file (RP=C, GIS_Link=10-1-1A, owner/situs/legal agree), but parseTadPropertyLine drops every RP value other than R without a skip count.
sampleVerification.dallasFinding: The 2026 DCAD source carries ACCOUNT_NUM plus GIS_PARCEL_ID; the current parser persists ACCOUNT_NUM only. Mapping coverage must be measured from source identity fields and verified against owner/situs/legal, not inferred from key shape.

preRegisteredFlipCriteria.denominator: All parcel-linked 2025 rows: rows with a txgio_parcel geometry link by the stored 2025 prop_id.
preRegisteredFlipCriteria.thresholdReason: A vintage declaration is county-wide. Requiring at least 99% deterministic one-to-one coverage bounds newly introduced parcel read gaps below 1%, while the residual must still be fully classified and counted; ambiguous mappings never count as covered.
additionalHardGates: 100% of parcel-linked 2025 rows are either identical-key hits, deterministic one-to-one mapped hits, or named vintage-gap residuals.
Zero one-to-many or many-to-one mappings are admitted by the resolver.
Every residual class has a count and sample evidence from owner/situs/legal/geometry.
Planner rules on each county flip; L21 does not edit current_tax_year.

48439.reason: The first verified orphan exists in the 2026 source under the same GIS_Link but was excluded from the loaded store by the RP=R parser filter; mapping cannot recover a row that was not loaded.

design.proposedStore: cad_property_vintage_crosswalk keyed by county_fips, from_tax_year, from_prop_id, to_tax_year with unique target enforcement, method, evidence class, and source provenance
design.resolverRule: Exact declared-year key first; on miss, resolve one deterministic crosswalk row and read the declared-year target; otherwise classify vintage-gap/not-found. No fuzzy runtime matching.

constraints: engine reader changes only through the existing L17 helper seam
one heavy shared-database scan at a time
